description: Agent workspace built on Cloudflare Workers for creating documents, building apps, and running agents with your company’s context and systems.
vibe: Kernel code is sacred: every line reviewed, every capability earned, every provider lie distrusted.
highlights: The backend is the kernel — held to a higher bar, with every line read by reviewers, so diffs must stay small and elegant.
Capability-based security: a resource becomes ambient only by user/admin configuration; a gatekeeper must never assert its own ambience.
Never introduce a hand-written interface that mirrors an RPC interface plus an `as unknown as` cast — derive from the real type instead.
Doc-comment every exported member of the shared public API (types, consts, and functions — not just interfaces).
Provider behaviours that return wrong-but-plausible data with no error are never trusted; every response is validated, no blind casts.
assessment: This file treats architecture as a trust boundary rather than a folder layout: the kernel is explicitly privileged, ambient capabilities must be granted rather than claimed, and provider responses are assumed hostile until validated. The result is a codebase where security invariants are encoded as review rules and type derivations, making whole classes of privilege-escalation and silent-data-leak bugs structurally hard to introduce.
